response.sql: WITH per_account AS (SELECT t.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(t.amount) AS account_average FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), per_frequency AS (SELECT frequency, AVG(account_average) AS frequency_average FROM per_account), ratios AS (SELECT p.account_id, p.frequency, p.account_average, p.account_average / NULLIF(f.frequency_average, 0) AS ratio FROM per_account AS p JOIN per_frequency AS f ON f.frequency = p.frequency) SELECT account_id, frequency, account_average, ratio FROM ratios ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
